name: Dev Canary Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  PYTHON_VERSION: "3.12"

jobs:
  deploy-modal:
    name: Deploy to Modal
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install modal

      - name: Deploy to Modal
        run: |
          bash distributed/deploy/modal-deploy.sh
        env:
          MODAL_TOKEN_ID: ${{ secrets.MODAL_TOKEN_ID }}
          MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET: ${{ secrets.MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET }}

  deploy-flyio:
    name: Deploy to Fly.io
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Deploy to Fly.io
        run: |
          bash distributed/deploy/fly-deploy.sh
        env:
          FLY_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FLY_API_TOKEN }}

  deploy-railway:
    name: Deploy to Railway
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Deploy to Railway
        run: |
          railway init && railway up
        env:
          RAILWAY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RAILWAY_TOKEN }}

  deploy-render:
    name: Deploy to Render
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Deploy to Render
        uses: render-actions/render-deploy@v1
        with:
          serviceId: ${{ secrets.RENDER_SERVICE_ID }}
          accessToken: ${{ secrets.RENDER_ACCESS_TOKEN }}

  deploy-daytona:
    name: Deploy to Daytona
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Daytona
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://download.daytona.io/daytona/install.sh | sh
          daytona create

  test-health-endpoints:
    name: Test Health Endpoints
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [deploy-modal, deploy-flyio, deploy-railway, deploy-render]
    steps:
      - name: Test Modal Health
        run: |
          curl -f http://your-modal-app-url/health

      - name: Test Fly.io Health
        run: |
          curl -f http://your-fly-app-url/health

      - name: Test Railway Health
        run: |
          curl -f http://your-railway-app-url/health

      - name: Test Render Health
        run: |
          curl -f http://your-render-app-url/health

  test-codespaces:
    name: Test Codespaces
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [deploy-daytona]
    steps:
      - name: Verify devcontainer.json exists
        run: |
          ls -la .devcontainer/devcontainer.json

      - name: Test Codespaces Setup
        run: |
          echo "Codespaces environment verified"
